response.title: which enclosed 3d printer prints abs and nylon without warping for under 1000
response.answer:
For ABS and nylon printing under $1,000, I'd prioritize an enclosed 3D printer with an actively heated chamber, rather than just a closed plastic enclosure.

The distinction matters:

ABS: An enclosed printer can often print small and medium parts without warping, but larger parts benefit significantly from a heated chamber.

Nylon (PA6, PA12): More challenging, especially unfilled nylon. A heated chamber, 280–300°C-capable nozzle, and dry filament are important.

Carbon-fiber nylon (PA-CF): Often warps less than unfilled nylon, but requires a hardened nozzle and preferably hardened extruder gears.

No printer can guarantee zero warping with every ABS or nylon geometry, but some are substantially better equipped than others.
